successors.name: Dutch East Indies
successors.text: the Mempawah River and its upper reaches, Pulau Pedalaman, Bukit Rama, Senggaok, Pekana, Karangan and Kuala Mempawah (Galah Herang)

rulers.name: Opu Daeng Menambun (Pangeran Mas Surya Negara)

ledger.x: c. 1610: Mempawah's government is founded at Pekana. The page: 'Two hundred years later, or around 1610, a new government was established' 'that was built on the former ruins of the Sidiniang Kingdom', and Raja Kudung moved his seat from Sidiniang to Pekana. The infobox's 'Established: 1740' is the Bugis dynasty…
c. 1610: 'Raja Kudung then moved the center of his government from Sidiniang to Pekana'.
1740: the court moves from Senggaok to Bukit Rama under Opu Daeng Menambun.

c. 1787: the Dutch land at Mempawah and fight its Panembahan. 'Not long after the Dutch landed in Mempawah in about 1787, there was a battle against the troops of Mempawah led by Panembahan Adiwijaya'; 'Syarif Kasim Alkadrie, son of Syarif Abdurrahman Alkadrie, was persuaded by the Dutch to join in the attack on…
27 August 1787: the Dutch install their candidate.
1790: 'in 1790, Panembahan Adiwijaya died before he could launch a counterattack and left 8 children from two wives.'
1800: the Dutch state takes over the VOC's possessions: the Dutch East Indies page says the colony 'came under the administration of the Dutch government in 1800'.

c. 1820: the Dutch-backed rule ends. 'When the Dutch were finally expelled from Mempawah, Gusti Jati was crowned the Sultan of Mempawah'; 'Sultan Muhammad Zainal Abidin's counterattack paid off, the Pontianak Sultanate's army was defeated.' The ruler list gives Syarif Husein 1808-1820 and Gusti Jati (Sultan Muhammad…
c. 1820: Sultan Muhammad Zainal Abidin moves the government to the banks of the Mempawah River.
1831: Dutch intervention ends Mempawah's restored independence.

wars.name: Dutch intervention in Mempawah
wars.outcome: Dutch victory: Panembahan Adiwijaya is beaten, withdraws to Karangan 'to arrange a counterattack' and dies there in 1790; the agreement of 27 August 1787 installs Syarif Kasim Alkadrie as Panembahan Mempawah.

wars.name: Mempawah-Pontianak dispute
wars.outcome: 'Around 1794, the dispute between Mempawah and the Pontianak Sultanate grew worse'; 'the war flared up again in which the Pontianak Sultanate was assisted by the Chinese in Pontianak'; 'because the Pontianak Sultanate was fully supported by the Dutch…

wars.name: Mempawah resistance against Pontianak and the Dutch
wars.outcome: Mempawah's victory: 'Sultan Muhammad Zainal Abidin's counterattack paid off, the Pontianak Sultanate's army was defeated', and 'When the Dutch were finally expelled from Mempawah, Gusti Jati was crowned the Sultan of Mempawah' (ruler list 1820-1831).

certainty.note: The page names the river and a few places but gives no boundary; the outline is Cliopatria's.
